This '''[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], and present at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The individual was part of a cadre of bounty hunters searching for a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] with good pay, and happened upon [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], this individual entered a life of crime as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], and around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] was present at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He stood alongside four other bounty hunters&mdash;one [[Unidentified Weequay bounty hunter/Legends|male]] and one female [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]], a [[Unidentified Balnab bounty hunter/Legends|member]] of a [[Species/Legends|species]] with distinctive facial tentacles, and a female Human.<ref name="Revenge" />

This bounty hunter had a laugh after the male Weequay told a [[Bartender/Legends|bartending]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to "shut its speakers," and was observing as the member of the unknown species was scrolled through a list of the latest [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]]. The five hunters happened upon the bounty for [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], who was worth the most [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] at one million.<ref name="Revenge" />

The male Weequay expressed his surprise, asking who Opress was, before this bounty hunter announced that they would take the bounty. Before the hunter could finish his sentence, the former [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] stepped in and said that this one was for her. Ventress walked up to the screen, pushing the hunter out of the way, and then transferred Opress's bounty to her [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].<ref name="Revenge" />

==Personality and traits==
This bounty hunter had a determined personality when it came to getting a bounty, and was the first of his group of bounty hunters to offer to take upon Savage Opress's bounty. He had a bald head, [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], tan skin, and wore a blue shirt and pants while on Tatooine.<ref name="Revenge" />
